title: Taskboard deployment
content: Taskboard deploys via GitHub Actions. Tags matching v*.*.* trigger a release that publishes images to GHCR and creates a GitHub Release.

title: Office hours
content: Support office hours are Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm EAT.
